From: Alice Brown <alice.brown@xylohealth.com>

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: CAIQ evidence snapshot for audit window

Hi Ben / Priya,

We're approaching an external compliance window next month and the audit team has asked for a concise CAIQ evidence snapshot covering our scoped controls. They want a single ZIP with the artifact matrix plus the authoritative copies (diagrams, config extracts, key rotation logs) and a short README that maps each artifact to the CAIQ question id.

Can Redwood provide an "audit snapshot" covering the controls we committed to for Xylo Health (scope: data-in-transit, key management, change control, logging retention)? Target delivery: the week of Dec 7th. If you prefer, we can accept a staged handoff (index + links first, artifacts by Dec 10).

Quick Qs:
- Is there a canonical CAIQ control index you use for exports?
- Do you have any artifacts that are sensitive and need a separate transfer method (SFTP / secure share)?

Appreciate a point person and an ETA.

Thanks,
Alice Brown
Security Operations
Xylo Health

Alice — thanks for the heads up.

I'll own the handoff. Plan below:
1) Ship a CAIQ control index (sheet) with mapped artifact names by Dec 7.
2) Deliver the artifact bundle (ZIP) with PDFs/CSV extracts and a README by Dec 10.
3) Provide a short walkthrough (15–20 min) on Dec 11 to confirm mapping and answer any auditor clarifications.

Notes / constraints: we have a few artifacts that include production identifiers (network diagrams and KMS audit logs). For those we'll either redact or provide via a secure, expiring Drive share; we can do SFTP if preferred.

Priya — can you compile the initial control index (CAIQ question id -> artifact short name) and assign owners? Irene, could you confirm whether the KMS rotation logs we export contain any customer PII that would require a different transfer method?

Ben
